new_and_change: Inspector (circle pool) – inspection report with fee assessment: licence/change fee, garbage fee, late fee, backlog fee, penalties and any other charges (addable)
BO (chosen by Inspector) – same fee fields; may revise. Forwards to Joint Director / Director, Special Secretary, or Issuing Authority directly
Joint Director / Director (optional) – approves and forwards to Special Secretary or Issuing Authority; notes; returns to BO
Special Secretary (optional) – final approval, or approves and forwards to Issuing Authority; notes (no visit date); returns to BO or Joint Director / Director
Issuing Authority (CCS / Secretary) – final approval, or return to the officer who sent it
Approved – Payment Pending: Inspector / BO may exempt late fee, backlog fee, penalties or other charges
Applicant generates challan, pays at the bank, uploads BR
BR (+ originals for new / change) verified – licence generated
renewal: Applicant submits renewal request: GST certificate; may add / remove items (documents of added items not already on the licence are asked); no fee shown
Inspector works out the fee: renewal fee + garbage fee (from the licence), late fee (system suggestion), backlog, penalties, other charges; forwards to BO
BO approves (fee fixed) – may revise the fee first
Applicant generates challan, pays, uploads BR; Inspector / BO verify BR
Licence renewed (same number); new version if items changed
workflow.remarksMandatory: On every return; and on every action of the Joint Director / Director, Special Secretary and Issuing Authority

sendBacks.BO → Applicant: resubmission goes to the same BO
sendBacks.Issuing Authority → sender: the officer who forwarded it (BO, Joint Director / Director or Special Secretary) acts again

workflow.renewalFine: Late fee: 45-day grace after 31 March (to 15 May); ₹5/day after that, counted to the first submission date; included by the Inspector in the fee assessment; may be exempted after approval; no cut-off
workflow.renewalWindow: Configurable by the Department Admin (fee-master.html): renewal opens 1–6 months before 31 March, default 2 months (1 February). While renewal is due, items are added / removed with the renewal; other change requests wait.
workflow.licenceNumberFormat: Awaited from the department (may depend on district, type etc.). Demo: UDD/TL/<circle>/<year>/<serial>. Renewal of an old licence keeps the old number with the year part changed. File No. removed from the licence print.
workflow.inspectionNotes: Visible to officers only. The applicant does not see inspection notes, fee assessments or officers' internal remarks; the fee is shown only after approval
workflow.fees: No fee master. Inspector (and BO) assess the itemised fee for each application; it is fixed on final approval. The licence keeps the first licence fee as its renewal amount; the Department Admin (ADM-01) can revise it per licence.
workflow.districts: Premises district dropdown lists all districts; businesses in any district may apply to the North-East circle (Headquarters)

documentRules: tl-flow.js docList() reads config.docTypes (document types master) and the documents mapped to every chosen item / sub-item. Change requests: documents per change type (name / premises / address / add-remove items) set in the document types master, plus optional "Other supporting documents" (several files). Renewal / item change: GST certificate + documents of added items not already on the licence. Mandatory wins.
itemsMaster: config.categories: item (purpose) → optional sub-items (activity). Department Admin can add, rename (earlier names kept), deactivate / activate items and sub-items and choose the extra documents each calls for from the document types master. Changes kept in config.itemHistory and the audit log. Each item also switches on the form questions it needs (hotel details, franchise, educational institute); other items do not show them.
